```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)

cat <- read_csv("../data/cat_task.csv")
cat$Task <- as.factor(cat$Task)

```



# Categorization Task

```{r}
model <- lmer(LogReactionTime ~ Task * Conceptual + (1 + Task | ID.true), data = cat)
summary(model)
```


```{r}
# 1️⃣ Fit your model as usual (Task can be a factor, or cTask contrast-coded)
# model <- lmer(RT ~ cTask * Conceptual + (1 + cTask | Subject), data = dcen)

# 2️⃣ Compute Task effect within each Conceptual condition
emm <- emmeans(model, ~ Task | Conceptual)             # Task factor, not contrast-coded
task_eff <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "Conceptual")

# 3️⃣ Convert to dataframe for manipulation
te <- as.data.frame(task_eff)

# 4️⃣ Extract Task effect estimates and SEs
task_effects <- te[, c("Conceptual", "estimate", "SE")]

# 5️⃣ Separate Animacy vs others
animacy_eff <- task_effects %>% filter(Conceptual == "Animacy") %>% pull(estimate)
animacy_se  <- task_effects %>% filter(Conceptual == "Animacy") %>% pull(SE)

other_eff   <- task_effects %>% filter(Conceptual != "Animacy") %>% pull(estimate)
other_se    <- task_effects %>% filter(Conceptual != "Animacy") %>% pull(SE)

# 6️⃣ Compute difference: Animacy vs mean of others
mean_other <- mean(other_eff)
diff <- animacy_eff - mean_other

# 7️⃣ Approximate standard error (assuming independence)
se_diff <- sqrt(animacy_se^2 + mean(other_se^2))

# 8️⃣ Compute z and p-value
z <- diff / se_diff
p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))

# 9️⃣ Print results
cat("Task effect difference (Animacy - mean of others):", round(diff, 4), "\n")
cat("Approximate SE:", round(se_diff, 4), "\n")
cat("Z-value:", round(z, 3), "\n")
cat("Approximate p-value:", round(p, 4), "\n")

```


```{r}

# Prepare data
task_effects <- te[, c("Conceptual", "estimate", "SE")]

# Compute upper and lower bounds for error bars
task_effects$upper <- task_effects$estimate + task_effects$SE
task_effects$lower <- task_effects$estimate - task_effects$SE

# Highlight Animacy
task_effects$highlight <- ifelse(task_effects$Conceptual == "Animacy", "Animacy", "Other")

# Keep original order of Conceptual labels
task_effects$Conceptual <- factor(task_effects$Conceptual, levels = task_effects$Conceptual)
```

```{r}
# Plot
ggplot(task_effects, aes(x = Conceptual, y = estimate, color = highlight)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.1, size = .5) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("Animacy" = "firebrick", "Other" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "Task effect",
    title = "Categorization Task",
    color = ""
  ) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "top",

    # labs(y = "Mean Reaction Time", x = "Experiment") +

```



## Analysis
```{r}
model <- lmer(LogReactionTime ~ Task * Conceptual + (1 + Task | ID.true), data = cat)

```

```{r}
# extract pairwise comparisons

task_eff <- contrast(emmeans(model, ~ Task | Conceptual),
                     method = "revpairwise")   # or "pairwise"

### Converto to a data grid.
task_eff_grid <- as.data.frame(task_eff)

# Reconstruct them to emm grid
te_grid <- update(task_eff, by = NULL)

# Animacy vs..
contrast(
  te_grid,
  list(Animacy_vs_Others = c(-3, 1, 1, 1)),
  adjust = "none"
)

```





# Similarity Judgment Task

```{r}
levels(as.factor(sim$FeatureMatch))

# First remove controls from FeatureMatch
sim <- sim %>% 
  filter(!FeatureMatch %in% c("DissimilarControl","SimilarControl"))

levels(as.factor(sim$FeatureMatch))
```


```{r}
model_fm <- lmer(Response ~ FeatureMatch * Conceptual + (1 + FeatureMatch | ID.Ibex), data = sim)

summary(model_fm)
```

```{r}
# Marginal means for FeatureMatch x Conceptual
emm_fm <- emmeans(model_fm, ~ FeatureMatch | Conceptual)

# Pairwise contrasts across FeatureMatch within each Conceptual
fm_eff <- contrast(emm_fm, method = "revpairwise", by = "Conceptual")

te_fm <- as.data.frame(fm_eff)
```


```{r}
# Compute the mean FeatureMatch effect per Conceptual
fm_effects <- aggregate(estimate ~ Conceptual, data = te_fm, FUN = mean)
fm_se <- aggregate(SE ~ Conceptual, data = te_fm, FUN = function(x) sqrt(mean(x^2)))
fm_effects$SE <- fm_se$SE

# Separate Animacy vs others
animacy_eff <- fm_effects$estimate[fm_effects$Conceptual == "Animacy"]
animacy_se  <- fm_effects$SE[fm_effects$Conceptual == "Animacy"]

other_eff <- fm_effects$estimate[fm_effects$Conceptual != "Animacy"]
other_se  <- fm_effects$SE[fm_effects$Conceptual != "Animacy"]

# Compute difference Animacy vs mean of others
mean_other <- mean(other_eff)
diff <- animacy_eff - mean_other

# Approximate SE
se_diff <- sqrt(animacy_se^2 + mean(other_se^2))
z <- diff / se_diff
p <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))

cat("FeatureMatch effect difference (Animacy - mean of others):", round(diff,4), "\n")
cat("Approx SE:", round(se_diff,4), "\n")
cat("Z-value:", round(z,3), "\n")
cat("p-value:", round(p,4), "\n")

```


```{r}

# Highlight Animacy
fm_effects$highlight <- ifelse(fm_effects$Conceptual == "Animacy", "Animacy", "Other")
fm_effects$Conceptual <- factor(fm_effects$Conceptual, levels = fm_effects$Conceptual)

# Add upper/lower for error bars
fm_effects$upper <- fm_effects$estimate + fm_effects$SE
fm_effects$lower <- fm_effects$estimate - fm_effects$SE
```



```{r}
ggplot(fm_effects, aes(x = Conceptual, y = estimate, color = highlight)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.1, size = .5) +
  # scale_color_manual(values = c("Animacy" = "firebrick", "Other" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = "FeatureMatch effect",
    title = "Similarity Judgement Task",
    color = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50")
    # labs(y = "Mean Reaction Time", x = "Experiment") +


ggsave("../graphs/sim_emmeans.jpg",width = 3, height = 4)

```


## Analysis

```{r}

fm_df <- as.data.frame(fm_eff)
unique(fm_df$contrast)

# extract pairwise comparisons
fm_eff <- contrast(emmeans(model_fm, ~ FeatureMatch | Conceptual),
                   method = "revpairwise")

fm_main <- subset(fm_eff, contrast == "ValenceMatchingOnly - TruthCondMatchingOnly")
fm_grid <- regrid(fm_main)

contrast(
  fm_grid,
  list(Animacy_vs_Others = c(-3, 1, 1, 1))
)

```
